inputs.checklistItemText: Transformer pads not located 100% on private property, located in public right-of-way, or straddling property lines
inputs.question: On the site plan, are all transformer pads clearly located on private property within the lot boundaries? Are any transformer pads at or near the property line?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking for presence/location verification of transformer pads relative to property boundaries (a feature-location check), not a precise distance measurement. This is a progressive verification step to identify whether pads exist and their general position relative to lot lines, before any quantitative clearance measurement would be needed.
